title: Calphalon Quartz heat toaster oven
text:
Calphalon Quartz heat toaster oven. UPDATE BELOW: I have had a different brand (breville), smaller oven for years... was going to buy another but then read reviews. YIKES. I wanted a bigger one - and landed on this one. The only problem is that the first one I got never got out "preheat" mode... it just never seemed to recognize that it was hot. This was right out of the box. So, I contacted Amazon and they sent another. Number 2 seemed to work great. NO problem with preheat - quickly preheats even at higher temps. It takes a fair amount of counter space... but not as much as some I have seen. The measurements given seem to be accurate. I haven't been using it for that long - so I will update my review should new info seem useful.
7/14/2019.... I have to say that I am SO SO disappointed with this toaster oven....I have really used it over a period of time to give it a fair shot. As others have reported, it really doesn't hold the temp and the preheat takes SO long it's really useless. I just spent 20 MINUTES trying to broil something - it NEVER got past "preheating" and then turned itself off. I am shopping for another. *sigh* I am sad that I wasted time and money on this one. I like the inside oven size and the look of the outside - it goes really well with my other brand new appliances - but looks have little to do with the actual use. I really wish the oven actually worked as it should. Now - in all fairness - if you ONLY make toast, this oven will work - it toasts. But really nothing else. So it's a bit over sized for just toast in my humble opinion.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Quartz Heat Countertop Toaster Oven, Stainless Steel, Extra-Large Capacity, Black, Dark Gray
features: Quartz heating element delivers 40% more even heat and preheats faster (Compared to conventional tube heating element)
Extra-large capacity can fit a 12” pizza
11 preset cooking functions: Bake, Pizza, Broil, Toast, Bagel, Roast, Defrost, Warm, Reheat, Cookies, Dehydrate
High-contrast LCD display for intuitive control of all features
Included accessories: baking pan, pizza pan, dehydrator rack, and wire rack
description: The Calphalon Quartz Heat Countertop Toaster Oven is designed with an innovative quartz heating element to deliver 40% more even heat*, for even cooking and crispy consistency. With faster preheat* and precise cooking, it saves you time and reduces the need to use your range oven. The built-in preset cooking functions feature all major cooking methods, including a dehydrator mode that easily makes apple chips, beef jerky, and more. It’s large enough to fit a 12” pizza, and precise enough to roast a chicken with delectable results. And, don’t forget about dessert—you can create delicious brownies, cupcakes, and pies with perfect consistency.
